summary: Intellia Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K on September 8, 2026, disclosing under Items 7.01 and 8.01 that the FDA accepted its Biologics License Application for lonvoguran ziclumeran (lonvo-z) in hereditary angioedema and granted Priority Review with a PDUFA target action date of March 10, 2027. The FDA also advised it does not currently plan an advisory committee. No deal, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is involved. This is a routine regulatory milestone disclosure, not a special situation; watch approval and launch execution.
